request_text_excerpt: Subject: CPRA 25-1475 — Documented Non-Consolidation Instruction, Withholding Review, and Processing Records To the City of Berkeley: My original submission for request 25-1475, recorded in NextRequest on June 21, 2025, expressly stated: “DO NOT COMBINE OR CONSOLIDATE THIS REQUEST.” “This request must remain separate from all previous filings.” This is a contemporaneous written objection. I never approved or authorized consolidation of my public records requests. Please preserve this instruction and do not characterize my continued correspondence as consent.
